Geometric Blue is made for relaxed family photos, beach walks, summer birthdays, and easy vacation mornings. The blue print keeps everyone coordinated while each piece still feels natural: breezy sleeveless dresses for moms and girls, crisp collared shirts for dads and boys, and simple pull-on shorts for the guys.

The look is polished without feeling precious. The repeated geometric motif photographs cleanly, the sleeveless dress shape keeps the mood warm-weather friendly, and the separates make it simple to build only the pieces each family member needs.

Key Features:

  • Four-role coordination: Dress, shirt, and shorts options cover moms, dads, girls, and boys.
  • Blue geometric palette: A deep blue ground with small repeated motifs keeps the set coordinated without looking too busy.
  • Mix-and-match pieces: Shirts and shorts can be selected separately for boys and dads.
  • Attached chart backed: Variants are built only from the supplied vendor size chart.
  • Draft-only safety: Created as an unpublished Shopify draft pending operator review.

Choose each role and size you need to build a crisp blue family matching look for the next sunny memory.
